source: App comparison pages and store listings read on 2026-11-14. Most comparisons are written by the apps themselves, so nothing here is a ranking.
note: Tools that do the daily jobs this plan does not: one line on what each is for and its main trade-off. No links that pay anyone, and no order of merit. Prices are left out because sources disagree on them.

tools.job: Which card to use at the register
tools.name: CardPointers
tools.does: Names the best card for each purchase, in store and online, from a very large card list.
tools.tradeoff: No bank login needed. Most of it sits behind a yearly plan.

tools.job: Which card to use at the register
tools.name: Kudos
tools.does: A browser add-on that shows your best card as you check out online and fills it in.
tools.tradeoff: Built for online shopping more than in-store.

tools.job: Bank offers switched on for you
tools.name: MaxRewards
tools.does: Turns on the offers your bank attaches to your cards so you do not have to tap each one.
tools.tradeoff: It needs your bank login to do it.

tools.job: Credits used before they run out
tools.name: MaxWorth
tools.does: Lists each card's monthly, quarterly and yearly credits and reminds you before one ends.
tools.tradeoff: You mark credits used yourself. No bank login.

tools.job: Credits used before they run out
tools.name: CardStack
tools.does: Spots credits you have used from your transactions and works out the fee you really pay.
tools.tradeoff: The automatic part needs a read-only bank link.

tools.job: Welcome offers and the 5 card limit, day to day
tools.name: Travel Freely
tools.does: Tracks your cards, offer deadlines, fee dates and when Chase opens up again. Free.
tools.tradeoff: It earns from card sign-ups, so read its suggestions with that in mind.

tools.name: AwardWallet
tools.does: Keeps the balances of your airline, hotel and card programs together.
tools.tradeoff: It tracks balances. It does not plan which card to open.
